## TemplateManager.getDescriptionLanguage() method

Gets available languages for a description.

**Signature:**

```typescript
getDescriptionLanguage(key: string, baseId?: string, scope?: string): string[];
```

## Remarks

Useful for determining which languages are defined for a command description.

## Example


